NOTE
**Still not ready — no linked issue**

New: CI now passes, and the author pushed three times, adding a second fixture for event-subscription payloads. Missing: the description has no "Fixes: #N", and the PR links no issue, so we can't tell whether the work is on a "help wanted" issue. The author has no merged PRs.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer yet. If no matching "help wanted" issue turns up, close the PR.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for getting CI passing! Before this can be reviewed, please link the issue it fixes with "Fixes: #N" in the description. Per our [contributing guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html), we only accept PRs for issues labeled "help wanted".
```
